content: Interactive test failures ROOT-CAUSED and fixed — NOT a script regression. Each of the 5 interactive tmux tests passes reliably in isolation (verified identity-guard 3/3, signing-generate, all 5 with per-test HOME). The consistent 3-pass/2-fail in run-all.sh was shared-HOME state leakage: earlier tests pre-harden the config, changing later tests' prompt count/timing and racing accept_until into a free-form prompt. Fixed test/interactive/run-all.sh to give each test a pristine HOME with its own script copy (+ clears SSH_AUTH_SOCK so a dev-box vault agent can't alter the signing-wizard path). Result: 5 passed, 0 failed on host; shellcheck clean. Re-running full container e2e via podman to confirm BATS+interactive green across distros. Also confirmed: the earlier --audit hang was solely my real 1Password agent (ssh-add -L) — still flagged as a bounded-probe robustness follow-up. Commit HELD.
